subject: Post-call: infra evidence & deployment path questions (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Bloom <ebloom@wellpathhealth.com>, ops@wellpathhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: infra evidence & deployment path questions (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Hi Evan — great to meet you and the ops team earlier. Quick recap from my side and the specific asks that will help us recommend the right deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem):

1) Identity & Access
- You said enterprise SSO is required and user provisioning has to be via SCIM. Please confirm whether SSO enforcement must be done at the network perimeter (e.g., no unauthenticated calls allowed even from service accounts) or if token-based service identity with short-lived tokens is acceptable for machine-to-machine calls.

2) Key management
- Recommendation depends on whether you need customer-managed KMS/HSM or Redwood KMS with BYOK. Can you confirm if customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault) are required for at-rest model artifacts and request logs?

3) Logging & retention
- You indicated 7 years for audit logs and 90 days for debug traces. We need machine-readable retention requirements (event types + minimum retention). If regulatory retention is negotiated per dataset, flag that.

4) Network & data residency
- Any requirement for on-prem inference (air-gapped) or is VPC-only acceptable? Also note: Dedicated reserved clusters can be placed in customer VPCs (private peering) in some regions — will that meet compliance?

Attachments: I attached a short checklist for SSO/KMS/loging evidence (SSO_requirements.xlsx) and a simple KMS diagram we discussed (KMS_arch_diagram.pdf).

Next steps I propose:
- Evan / Ops: reply with SCIM provisioning model + confirmation on customer-managed KMS need (by Tue 4/13)
- Redwood (Marissa/Karthik): map answers to recommended deployment path + a minimal evidence list for procurement

If you prefer, we can convert this to a mutual action plan in HubSpot and share a DocuSign SOW for Dedicated capacity pilots.

Thanks again — will standby for the SCIM/KMS/retention clarifications.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: infra evidence & deployment path questions (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from ops team below: 

- SCIM: we will require SCIM provisioning for user accounts and SAML SSO (Okta). Machine/service accounts may use short-lived tokens issued by our secrets manager, but enforcement must be auditable. We cannot allow permanent service API keys.

- KMS/HSM: customer-managed KMS is a hard requirement for encryption-at-rest of customer data and logs. We use AWS KMS with centralized key policies today. HSM-backed keys preferred for master key material.

- Logging: retention is driven by compliance. High-level: audit logs (7 years), admin-change logs (5 years), request-level traces (90 days). Logs with PHI must remain in our managed S3 buckets — we cannot have long-term storage in third-party buckets unless encrypted with our KMS and access-restricted.

- Network: dedicated VPC peering with private subnets + no public egress is acceptable. Air-gapped on-prem is not required for phase 1, but we need that to be a possible future path.

Attached a one-page PDF that lists our encryption and logging policy excerpts. Let us know if you need the actual KMS key policy or sample SCIM mapping.

Evan
Ops Director | WellPath Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: mapping Evan's asks to deployment options

Vanessa / Karthik — quick internal note after Evan's reply:

- SSO/SCIM + Okta + no permanent API keys -> both Dedicated and Private can meet this. Hosted will require workarounds (short-lived tokens + per-customer token routing) and likely additional compliance review.

- Customer-managed KMS with HSM preference -> Hosted (our multi-tenant hosted) cannot support HSM-backed customer keys today. Dedicated in-customer VPC with BYOK to their KMS or Private on-prem will cover requirements. Recommend marking "Private or Dedicated" as the likely paths.

- Logging retention + PHI in customer's S3 -> Private (VPC deployment) or Dedicated with customer-controlled log delivery to their S3 buckets is fine; need to confirm whether Redwood must maintain copies for support/quality (we can offer ephemeral debug copies under NDA).

Action items for us:
1) Create a 1-pager that maps each requirement to evidence (KMS key policy snippet, SCIM mapping example, logging retention matrix).
2) Draft a Dedicated pilot SOW variant that includes VPC peering + BYOK + log delivery to customer's S3.
3) Flag potential compliance/legal questions about HSM key escrow (if any) and whether Redwood will require key-escrow for recovery — get legal to weigh in.

I can draft the 1-pager and SOW outline; Karthik can flag any runtime constraints we need to call out (quantization, model artifact handling under customer KMS).

-Marissa

Evan — thanks for the detailed answers and the policy excerpt, very helpful. Short response and next steps: 

1) Deployment recommendation (phase 1): Dedicated capacity deployed into your VPC with BYOK (AWS KMS) and private log delivery to your S3. This meets HSM-backed key requirements (if you provide HSM-backed CMKs) and keeps PHI in your buckets.

2) Evidence packet we'll deliver by Fri 4/16:
   - SCIM mapping example and SAML metadata
   - Sample KMS key policy + guidance for HSM-backed CMKs
   - Logging retention matrix and delivery mechanics (how we can stream to your S3 with server-side encryption using your KMS)
   - Dedicated pilot SOW draft (30-day pilot, capacity profile, rollback & data-handling clauses)

3) Questions for you: can you confirm the team owner for providing the KMS key policy and a sample SCIM group mapping? Also confirm whether we should include legal on the SOW share or route through procurement first.

I'll turn Marissa's checklist into a customer-facing evidence packet and share a HubSpot MAP so we can track approvals. I'll also attach a short Dedicated pilot SOW draft for initial review.

Regards,
